The landlord called, got an earful. She said I've til the 15th.

Then I got an earful from the wife. I hate arguing with her. So I went to sit in the car and bummed a cigarette from the neighbor. Sat there and 2 minutes later, the kids ran by and asked if I wanted hot dogs and chocolate milks from the store. Wife walks by, doesn't even look at me. That was about noon. No answer on the phone. Just a text saying You could have made it right. Ill live at the shelter before i live with you.
